Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 65

“In serenity all sorrows are destroyed, for the understanding of one whose mind is serene soon becomes steady.”

The order is worth noticing — serenity comes first and steadies the intellect, not the other way around. Clarity is presented as a consequence of peace, not as its prerequisite.
